src: America's Test Kitchen — Andrew Janjigian — "Cod and Potato Cakes"

time.en: not given | Cook: not given | Total: 75 min

en.v: paring knife, microwave-safe bowl, 30 cm nonstick skillet, potato ricer or potato masher, fork, large plate, 80 ml measure, large zipper-lock bag, rolling pin, shallow dish, fish spatulas, paper towel–lined plate

sk.v: Nôž na lúpanie, miska vhodná do mikrovlnnej rúry, 30 cm nepriľnavá panvica, lis na zemiaky alebo štuchadlo, vidlička, veľký tanier, odmerka 80 ml, veľké uzatvárateľné vrecko, valček, plytká miska, obracačky na ryby, tanier vystlaný papierovou utierkou

en.v: not given by source (the shaped, uncoated cakes can be wrapped in plastic wrap and refrigerated for at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours instead of freezing them for 15 minutes)

sk.v: zdroj neuvádza (vytvarované neobalené placky môžeme namiesto 15 minút v mrazničke zabaliť do potravinovej fólie a nechať v chladničke aspoň 1 hodinu a najviac 24 hodín)

en.t: 1 large russet potato (340 g), unpeeled
2 tbsp (28 g) unsalted butter
4 scallions, white and light green parts minced, dark green parts sliced thin
2 garlic cloves, minced
1 tsp (5 ml) minced fresh thyme
1 tsp (6 g) table salt
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) pepper
1 (455 g) skinless cod fillet, cut into 5 cm pieces
1 large egg, lightly beaten
38 g panko bread crumbs
120 ml vegetable oil, for frying

1. Using paring knife, poke potato 8 times over entire surface. Place in bowl, cover, and microwave until knife glides easily through flesh and potato yields to gentle pressure, 10 to 15 minutes, flipping potato after 7 minutes. Halve lengthwise and let cool, cut side up, for 10 minutes.

2. While potato cools, melt butter in 30 cm nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add minced scallions, garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper and cook until softened, about 2 minutes. Add cod and cook until thickest pieces of cod just begin to flake, 5 to 7 minutes, flipping cod halfway through cooking. Set aside.

3. Peel potato and pass through potato ricer or mash with potato masher. Measure 175 ml (about 3/4 of a 240 ml measure) very firmly packed potato and transfer to bowl. Fluff with fork. Add cod mixture and sliced scallions and gently stir to combine (cod will break up). Add egg and gently stir to combine. Spray large plate and 80 ml measure with vegetable oil spray. Scoop level amount of mixture and drop onto prepared plate. Repeat with remaining mixture to make 8 mounds. Distribute any remaining mixture evenly among mounds. Freeze for 15 minutes. (Alternatively, plate can be wrapped in plastic wrap and refrigerated for at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours.)

4. Place panko in large zipper-lock bag and lightly crush with rolling pin. Transfer to shallow dish. Carefully pat each mound into 6.5 cm-wide, 2.5 cm-thick disk. Coat top and bottom of each disk with panko, pressing gently to adhere. Return cakes to plate.

5. Heat oil in 30 cm nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Place cakes in skillet and cook, without moving them, until first side is golden brown, about 4 minutes. Carefully flip cakes and cook until second side is golden brown, about 4 minutes. Transfer cakes to paper towel–lined plate and let drain for 1 minute. Season with salt to taste, and serve.

1. Zemiak nožom na lúpanie popicháme na 8 miestach po celom povrchu. Vložíme ho do misky, prikryjeme a v mikrovlnnej rúre ohrievame, kým nôž ľahko neprejde dužinou a zemiak pri jemnom stlačení nepoddá, 10 – 15 minút; po 7 minútach ho obrátime. Pozdĺžne ho rozpolíme a necháme 10 minút chladnúť reznou stranou nahor.

2. Kým zemiak chladne, v 30 cm nepriľnavej panvici na strednom ohni rozpustíme maslo. Pridáme nasekanú bielu a svetlozelenú časť jarnej cibuľky, cesnak, tymián, soľ a korenie a dusíme do mäkka, asi 2 minúty. Pridáme tresku a opekáme, kým sa najhrubšie kúsky nezačnú rozpadávať na lupienky, 5 – 7 minút; v polovici ich obrátime. Odložíme.

3. Zemiak ošúpeme a pretlačíme cez lis na zemiaky alebo roztlačíme štuchadlom. Odmeriame 175 ml (asi ¾ odmerky 240 ml) veľmi pevne natlačeného zemiaka a preložíme ho do misy. Vidličkou ho prekypríme. Pridáme zmes s treskou a nakrájanú tmavozelenú časť cibuľky a opatrne premiešame (treska sa rozpadne). Pridáme vajce a opatrne premiešame. Veľký tanier a 80 ml odmerku postriekame olejom v spreji. Naberieme zarovnanú odmerku zmesi a vyklopíme ju na pripravený tanier. Postup zopakujeme so zvyšnou zmesou, aby vzniklo 8 kôpok. Prípadný zvyšok zmesi rovnomerne rozdelíme medzi kôpky. Dáme na 15 minút do mrazničky. (Tanier môžeme namiesto toho zabaliť do potravinovej fólie a dať do chladničky aspoň na 1 hodinu a najviac na 24 hodín.)

4. Panko vsypeme do veľkého uzatvárateľného vrecka a zľahka ho podrvíme valčekom. Preložíme ho do plytkej misky. Každú kôpku opatrne vytvarujeme na placku širokú 6,5 cm a hrubú 2,5 cm. Vrch aj spodok každej placky obalíme v strúhanke panko a zľahka pritlačíme, aby sa prichytila. Placky vrátime na tanier.

5. V 30 cm nepriľnavej panvici na stredne silnom ohni rozohrejeme olej, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Vložíme placky a bez hýbania ich opekáme, kým prvá strana nie je zlatistohnedá, asi 4 minúty. Opatrne ich obrátime a opekáme, kým aj druhá strana nie je zlatistohnedá, asi 4 minúty. Preložíme ich na tanier vystlaný papierovou utierkou a necháme 1 minútu odkvapkať. Podľa chuti osolíme a podávame.

en.v: 200 °C, 8–12 min (breaded: spray with oil), turn breaded pieces halfway (preheat 3 min; don't crowd the basket — cook in batches).
oven 220 °C (fan 200 °C) on a rack over a lined tray, about 1.5–2× the air-fryer time, turning halfway.

sk.v: 200 °C, 8–12 min (obaľované: postriekať olejom), obaľované kúsky v polovici obrátiť (predhriať 3 min; kôš neprepĺňať — pripravovať po dávkach).
rúra 220 °C (teplovzdušná 200 °C) na mriežke nad vystlaným plechom, asi 1,5–2-násobok času vo fritéze, v polovici obrátiť.

en.v: the source says the recipe works with other flaky white fish such as haddock, pollock or hake; buy 565 g skin-on fillet to yield 455 g skinless. Serve with lemon wedges and/or the source's Quick Tartar Sauce (not included).

sk.v: podľa zdroja recept funguje aj s inou bielou rybou, ktorá sa rozpadá na lupienky, napríklad s treskou jednoškvrnnou, tmavou treskou (pollock) alebo merlúzou; kúpte 565 g filetu s kožou, aby po stiahnutí kože zostalo 455 g. Podávajte s mesiačikmi citróna a/alebo s rýchlou tatárskou omáčkou podľa zdroja (nie je súčasťou receptu).

cat.sk: Vytvarované rybie placky pred vyprážaním chlaďte 30 minút; spevnia a na panvici držia pohromade.

src: Serious Eats — Tim Chin — "Fried Calamari With Red Sauce Recipe" + red sauce: Serious Eats — Daniel Gritzer — "Quick and Easy Italian-American Red Sauce", https://www.seriouseats.com/easy-italian-amercian-red-sauce-recipe

en.v: Two rimmed baking sheets and two wire racks; Dutch oven or wok

sk.v: Dva plechy s okrajom a dve mriežky, liatinový hrniec alebo wok

en.v: The calamari can be soaked in milk up to 2 hours before frying, but is best fried immediately before serving.

sk.v: Kalamáre môžeme namočiť do mlieka až 2 hodiny pred vyprážaním, najlepšie je však vyprážať ich tesne pred podávaním.

en.t: 120 ml milk
1 tsp (3 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt use half as much by volume or the same weight
454 g cleaned squid, bodies sliced into 2 cm thick rings, tentacles left whole
200 g all-purpose flour
44 g cornstarch
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) freshly ground black pepper
1/4 tsp (1 g) baking powder
1890 ml vegetable or other neutral oil
2 tbsp (30 ml) extra-virgin olive oil, for the red sauce
4 garlic cloves, crushed, for the red sauce
generous pinch of red pepper flakes, for the red sauce
1 tsp (2 g) dried oregano, for the red sauce
3 tbsp (50 g) tomato paste, for the red sauce
2 cans (794 g each) whole peeled tomatoes, for the red sauce
1 large sprig basil, for the red sauce
kosher salt, for the red sauce
2 tbsp (28 g) unsalted butter (optional), for the red sauce
Lemon wedges, for serving

1. Make the red sauce: In a large pot, heat the oil and garlic over moderately low heat until the garlic gently sizzles. Add the pepper flakes and cook, stirring, until the garlic just turns light golden, about 3 minutes. Add the oregano and cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring, until softened and blended with the oil, about 3 minutes.

2. Stir in the tomatoes and their juices, bring to a gentle simmer over medium-high heat, then lower the heat to maintain it. Blend with an immersion blender until smooth (or crush the tomatoes by hand before adding them). Add the basil and simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly reduced and rich, about 30 minutes. Season with salt, discard the basil, and stir in the butter, if using. (The sauce keeps in the refrigerator for up to 5 days or in the freezer for up to 6 months.)
3. In a medium bowl, whisk together milk and salt. Add squid and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate squid for at least 30 minutes and up to 2 hours.
4. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, pepper, and baking powder until thoroughly combined, about 30 seconds. Set aside.

5. Set a wire rack in a rimmed baking sheet and place a colander on top of the rack. Set a second wire rack in another rimmed baking sheet and line rack with paper towels. Heat oven to 95 °C (fan 75 °C).

6. Using clean hands, remove half of squid from milk mixture, allowing excess liquid to drain back into bowl, then transfer to flour mixture. Toss squid to coat evenly. Gently shake off excess flour and transfer squid to colander set over wire rack. Shake colander to sift out any excess flour, then transfer squid in a single layer to wire rack. Repeat with remaining squid. Let dredged squid rest for 15 minutes.

7. Meanwhile, heat oil in Dutch oven or wok over high heat to 185 °C. Add half of squid and fry until golden brown, stirring occasionally to prevent pieces from sticking to each other, about 3 minutes (the oil temperature will drop significantly once the squid is added; adjust heat to maintain temperature between 135 and 150 °C).
8. Using a slotted spoon or spider, transfer calamari to prepared paper towel–lined rack, season lightly with salt, then transfer to oven to keep warm.
9. Skim any browned bits from oil and discard. Return oil to 185 °C and repeat with remaining squid.
10. Transfer calamari to plate and serve immediately with red sauce and lemon wedges.

1. Pripravíme paradajkovú omáčku: vo veľkom hrnci zohrejeme na miernom ohni olej s cesnakom, kým cesnak jemne nezačne prskať. Pridáme drvenú čili papričku a za stáleho miešania opekáme, kým cesnak nezíska svetlozlatú farbu, asi 3 minúty. Pridáme oregano a za stáleho miešania opekáme 1 minútu. Pridáme paradajkový pretlak a za stáleho miešania opekáme, kým nezmäkne a nespojí sa s olejom, asi 3 minúty.

2. Vmiešame paradajky aj so šťavou, na stredne silnom ohni privedieme k miernemu varu a potom oheň stlmíme tak, aby sa var udržal. Ponorným mixérom rozmixujeme dohladka (alebo paradajky pred pridaním rozmačkáme rukami). Pridáme bazalku a za občasného miešania dusíme, kým omáčka mierne nezhustne a nemá plnú chuť, asi 30 minút. Osolíme, bazalku vyberieme a podľa chuti vmiešame maslo. (Omáčka vydrží v chladničke až 5 dní alebo v mrazničke až 6 mesiacov.)
3. V strednej mise metličkou zmiešame mlieko a soľ. Pridáme kalamáre a premiešame, aby sa obalili. Prikryjeme a dáme do chladničky aspoň na 30 minút a najviac na 2 hodiny.
4. Vo veľkej mise metličkou dôkladne zmiešame múku, kukuričný škrob, korenie a kypriaci prášok do pečiva, asi 30 sekúnd. Odložíme.

5. Do plechu s okrajom vložíme mriežku a na ňu postavíme cedník. Do druhého plechu s okrajom vložíme druhú mriežku a vystelieme ju papierovými utierkami. Rúru rozohrejeme na 95 °C (teplovzdušnú na 75 °C).

6. Čistými rukami vyberieme polovicu kalamárov z mliečnej zmesi, prebytočnú tekutinu necháme stiecť späť do misy, a preložíme ich do múčnej zmesi. Premiešame, aby sa rovnomerne obalili. Jemne striasieme prebytočnú múku a kalamáre preložíme do cedníka nad mriežkou. Cedníkom potrasieme, aby sme preosiali prebytočnú múku, potom kalamáre rozložíme v jednej vrstve na mriežku. Zopakujeme so zvyšnými kalamármi. Obalené kalamáre necháme 15 minút odpočívať.

7. Medzitým v liatinovom hrnci alebo woku zohrejeme na silnom ohni olej na 185 °C. Pridáme polovicu kalamárov a vyprážame dozlatista, asi 3 minúty; občas premiešame, aby sa kúsky nezlepili (po vložení kalamárov teplota oleja výrazne klesne; oheň upravujeme tak, aby sa udržala medzi 135 a 150 °C).
8. Dierovanou lyžicou alebo cedidlovou naberačkou preložíme kalamáre na pripravenú mriežku s papierovými utierkami, zľahka osolíme a vložíme do rúry, aby zostali teplé.
9. Z oleja vyberieme a vyhodíme opečené zvyšky. Olej znova zohrejeme na 185 °C a zopakujeme so zvyšnými kalamármi.
10. Kalamáre preložíme na tanier a hneď podávame s paradajkovou omáčkou a mesiačikmi citróna.

en.v: instead of frying as in the method below, the dish can be made in the air fryer.

c.t: Oil: 1–2 tbsp oil, sprayed or brushed on (instead of the frying oil)
Air fryer: 200 °C, 6–8 min, shaking halfway (preheat 3 min; don't crowd the basket — cook in batches)
Steps:
1. Make the red sauce and coat the squid as in steps 1–6.
2. Spray the squid all over with oil until no dry flour is visible and spread it in the basket in a single layer.
3. Air-fry until golden and crisp, 6–8 minutes, shaking the basket halfway. Season lightly with salt and serve with the red sauce and lemon wedges.

en.v: Ackee and saltfish is best served immediately. The salt cod can be soaked, cooked, flaked, and stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to one week. Prepared salt cod can also be frozen in an airtight container and kept in the freezer for up to three months

sk.v: Ackee so solenou treskou je najlepšie podávať hneď. Solenú tresku môžeme namočiť, uvariť, rozobrať na kúsky a uchovávať v uzatvárateľnej nádobe v chladničke až týždeň. Pripravenú tresku môžeme tiež zmraziť v uzatvárateľnej nádobe a uchovávať v mrazničke až tri mesiace

en.t: 225 g salt cod
2 tbsp (30 ml) neutral oil, such as canola or vegetable
2 tbsp (28 g) diced yellow onion, from 1/4 onion
2 heaping tbsp (28 g) diced bell pepper, from 1/2 bell pepper
1/2 Scotch bonnet chile, stemmed, seeded, and minced
2 garlic cloves, minced
1 small tomato (about 56 g), cored and diced
1 scallion (10 g), thinly sliced
2 tbsp (3 g) fresh thyme leaves and tender stems, chopped
One 510–565 g can ackee
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
Sliced avocado, for serving

1. Rinse salt cod under cold running water until any salt on its surface is washed away. Transfer to a medium bowl and cover with fresh water. Soak at room temperature for 1 hour, or cover and refrigerate overnight. Drain salt cod, discard soaking water, transfer fish to a small saucepan, and cover with fresh water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, and cook until fish flakes easily when prodded with a fork, about 40 minutes. Taste, and if the cod is still too salty—it should have a similar salinity to bacon—drain and discard cooking water, return fish to saucepan, cover with a fresh change of water, and boil for an additional 20 minutes. Once the salt cod is cooked and seasoned to your liking, drain and flake fish into 1.5–2.5 cm pieces, discarding any bones and silvery membranes. Set aside.
2. In a 30 cm skillet, heat oil over medium heat until shimmering. Add onion, bell pepper, Scotch bonnet, and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the flaked salt cod and cook, stirring occasionally, until fish is heated through, about 5 minutes.
4. Add tomato, scallion, and thyme, stir to combine, and cook until vegetables are tender and mixture is aromatic, about 5 minutes.

5. Add ackee, stir gently to incorporate, taking care not to over-mix which can cause the ackee to become mushy, and cook until ackee is heated through, about 3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve immediately with sliced avocado alongside.

1. Solenú tresku oplachujeme pod studenou tečúcou vodou, kým sa z povrchu nezmyje všetka soľ. Preložíme ju do strednej misy a zalejeme čerstvou vodou. Necháme namáčať 1 hodinu pri izbovej teplote alebo prikrytú cez noc v chladničke. Tresku scedíme, vodu z namáčania vylejeme, rybu preložíme do malého kastróla a zalejeme čerstvou vodou. Na stredne silnom až silnom ohni privedieme do varu a varíme, kým sa ryba ľahko nerozpadá pri dotyku vidličkou, asi 40 minút. Ochutnáme, a ak je treska stále príliš slaná (mala by byť výrazne, ale príjemne slaná), vodu vylejeme, rybu vrátime do kastróla, zalejeme čerstvou vodou a varíme ďalších 20 minút. Keď je treska uvarená a slaná podľa našej chuti, scedíme ju a rozoberieme na kúsky veľké 1,5 – 2,5 cm, kosti a strieborné blany vyhodíme. Odložíme.

2. V panvici s priemerom 30 cm zohrejeme na strednom ohni olej, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme cibuľu, papriku, papričku Scotch bonnet a cesnak a za občasného miešania opekáme, kým nezmäknú, asi 5 minút.
3. Pridáme rozobranú tresku a za občasného miešania zohrievame, kým sa ryba neprehreje, asi 5 minút.
4. Pridáme paradajku, jarnú cibuľku a tymian, premiešame a dusíme, kým zelenina nezmäkne a zmes nezavonia, asi 5 minút.

5. Pridáme ackee a jemne ho vmiešame; dávame pozor, aby sme ho nepremiešali, inak sa rozmočí. Zohrievame, kým sa ackee neprehreje, asi 3 minúty. Podľa chuti osolíme a okoreníme a hneď podávame s plátkami avokáda.

cat.en: Add the ackee right at the end and only warm it through, so it keeps some texture instead of turning to mush.
cat.sk: Akí pridajte až úplne na konci a len ho prehrejte, aby si zachovalo štruktúru a nerozvarilo sa na kašu.

c.t: Instead of finnan haddie you can cold-smoke any lean white fish (haddock, cod, halibut) at home. Brine: dissolve 60 g salt, 30 g sugar, 2 bay leaves and 15 black peppercorns in 500 ml water over high heat, take off the heat and add 1500 ml cold water (or 500 g ice). When fully cool, soak the fish in it in the refrigerator for 1 hour, then set it on a rack over a rimmed baking sheet at room temperature, uncovered, for 1 to 2 hours.

Then refrigerate it uncovered for at least 1 and up to 24 hours. Smoke it in a cold smoker with cherry or other wood for about 4 hours; or put it in a zip-top bag, fill the bag with smoke from a smoking gun, seal and refrigerate for 30 minutes, and repeat for 5 or 6 cycles in total.

Namiesto finnan haddie môžete doma studeným dymom vyúdiť akúkoľvek chudú bielu rybu (treska jednoškvrnná, treska, halibut). Lák: v 500 ml vody na silnom ohni rozpustite 60 g soli, 30 g cukru, 2 bobkové listy a 15 zrniek čierneho korenia, odstavte a pridajte 1500 ml studenej vody (alebo 500 g ľadu). Keď úplne vychladne, nechajte v ňom rybu 1 hodinu v chladničke, potom ju položte na mriežku nad plechom s okrajom a nechajte ju odokrytú 1 až 2 hodiny pri izbovej teplote.

Potom ju nechajte odokrytú v chladničke aspoň 1 a najviac 24 hodín. Údte ju v udiarni na studený dym s čerešňovým alebo iným drevom asi 4 hodiny; alebo ju vložte do uzatvárateľného vrecka, naplňte ho dymom z udiacej pištole, uzavrite a dajte na 30 minút do chladničky, spolu 5 alebo 6 takýchto cyklov.

Kosher or sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

1. In a 2840 ml saucepan, heat milk with bay leaf over medium heat until nearly simmering. Add fish and cook until just starting to flake. Using a slotted spoon, remove fish to paper towels to drain; set aside. Discard bay leaf. Transfer milk to heatproof mixing bowl or other container; set aside.
2. Wash saucepan and return to medium heat. Add butter and cook until melted. Add onion and cook, stirring frequently, until nicely softened but not browned, about 6 minutes.
3. Return milk to saucepan and add potatoes. Return milk to bare simmer. Then cook until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes; stir and scrape saucepan occasionally to prevent milk from scorching.
4. Using a potato masher or large wooden spoon, crush potatoes in pot until partially mashed. You want a good range of potato bits, some so small they thicken the broth but also larger chunks.

5. Remove and discard any skin or bones from fish; then flake into the soup. Add cream. Season with salt and pepper, and, if desired, stir in pinch of cayenne. Serve, sprinkling chives on top of each bowl.

c.t: Potato is common but optional: it makes a milder, softer, creamier brandade and stretches the quantity. Without it, for a stronger salt-cod flavour and more bite, cut the olive oil to 175 ml and the half-and-half to 60 ml.
The cooked garlic gives a mellow flavour; for more punch, add 2 minced raw cloves while whipping.

Zemiaky sú bežné, ale nepovinné: brandáda je s nimi jemnejšia, mäkšia, krémovejšia a je jej viac. Bez nich, pre výraznejšiu chuť solenej tresky a pevnejšiu textúru, znížte olivový olej na 175 ml a zmes mlieka a smotany na 60 ml.
Uvarený cesnak dá jemnú chuť; pre výraznejšiu pridajte pri šľahaní 2 nasekané surové strúčiky.

en.t: 455 g salt cod
225 g whole russet potatoes (about 2 medium potatoes)
5 medium whole cloves garlic, plus 2 optional minced medium cloves garlic, divided
3 sprigs fresh thyme
1 bay leaf
295 ml extra-virgin olive oil (or 175 ml if no potato)
120 ml half-and-half (or 59 ml if no potato)
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
2 tbsp (30 ml) finely chopped flat-leaf parsley leaves and tender stems (optional)
Zest of 1/2 lemon (optional)
Crackers or baguette toasts, for serving

1. Rinse salt cod under cold running water until any salt on its surface is washed away. Transfer to a large container (cut the salt cod into smaller pieces if it doesn't fit whole) and cover with fresh water. Refrigerate for 24 hours, changing the water several times during that period.

2. Bake potatoes in a 175 °C (fan 155 °C) oven until easily pierced with a fork, about 1 hour. Alternatively, put potatoes in a medium saucepan and cover with cold unsalted water; set over medium-high heat, bring to a simmer, and cook until easily pierced with a fork, about 45 minutes. Split potatoes lengthwise, scoop flesh from potato skins, and mash using a food mill, ricer, or potato masher. Set aside.

3. Meanwhile, drain salt cod and place in a medium saucepan. Cover with cold unsalted water and add 5 whole cloves garlic, thyme, and bay leaf. Set over medium-high heat and bring to a simmer. Cook for 10 minutes, then remove from heat and let stand in cooking liquid for 20 minutes.
4. Drain salt cod, reserving garlic; discard thyme and bay leaf. Flake salt cod, discarding any bones and silvery membranes.

5. Transfer salt cod and reserved cooked garlic to a stand mixer fitted with the paddle; add remaining 2 minced garlic cloves for a more intense garlic flavor. With the mixer running at medium-high speed, drizzle in the olive oil until fully incorporated. Then drizzle in half-and-half until fully incorporated.
6. Add mashed potatoes and whip just long enough to fully incorporate. Season with salt and pepper, and mix in optional flavorings, like minced parsley or lemon zest, if using.

7. Serve the brandade at room temperature with crackers or baguette toasts, or serve it warm and browned on top by transferring to an oven-safe baking dish or gratin dish and baking at 175 °C (fan 155 °C) for 10 minutes; then broil until browned on top, about 3 minutes.
oil amount unchanged — here the oil is the base of the emulsion/sauce or cooking liquid and cannot be cut without breaking the dish; keep portions small — own adjustment
lactose-free whipping cream (30–33%) instead of cream — own adjustment

1. Solenú tresku oplachujeme pod studenou tečúcou vodou, kým sa z povrchu nezmyje všetka soľ. Preložíme ju do veľkej nádoby (ak sa nezmestí celá, nakrájame ju na menšie kusy) a zalejeme čerstvou vodou. Dáme na 24 hodín do chladničky a počas toho niekoľkokrát vymeníme vodu.

2. Zemiaky pečieme v rúre vyhriatej na 175 °C (teplovzdušnej na 155 °C), kým sa nedajú ľahko prepichnúť vidličkou, asi 1 hodinu. Prípadne ich dáme do stredného kastróla a zalejeme studenou nesolenou vodou; na stredne silnom až silnom ohni privedieme do mierneho varu a varíme, kým sa nedajú ľahko prepichnúť vidličkou, asi 45 minút. Zemiaky rozkrojíme pozdĺžne, dužinu vyberieme zo šupiek a roztlačíme pasírovacím mlynčekom, lisom alebo štuchadlom. Odložíme.

3. Medzitým tresku scedíme a dáme do stredného kastróla. Zalejeme studenou nesolenou vodou a pridáme 5 celých strúčikov cesnaku, tymian a bobkový list. Na stredne silnom až silnom ohni privedieme do mierneho varu. Varíme 10 minút, potom odstavíme z ohňa a necháme 20 minút postáť vo vývare.
4. Tresku scedíme, cesnak si odložíme; tymian a bobkový list vyhodíme. Tresku rozoberieme na lupienky, kosti a strieborné blany vyhodíme.

5. Tresku a odložený uvarený cesnak preložíme do misy kuchynského robota s plochou miešacou metlou; pre výraznejšiu cesnakovú chuť pridáme zvyšné 2 nasekané strúčiky cesnaku. Za chodu robota na stredne vysokej rýchlosti prilievame olivový olej, kým sa úplne nezapracuje. Potom prilievame zmes mlieka a smotany, kým sa úplne nezapracuje.
6. Pridáme roztlačené zemiaky a šľaháme len tak dlho, kým sa úplne nezapracujú. Osolíme, okoreníme a podľa chuti vmiešame voliteľné prísady, napríklad nasekanú petržlenovú vňať alebo citrónovú kôru.

7. Brandade podávame pri izbovej teplote s krekrami alebo opečenými plátkami bagety, alebo teplú a navrchu zapečenú: preložíme ju do zapekacej misy vhodnej do rúry a pečieme pri 175 °C (teplovzdušnej 155 °C) 10 minút; potom ju dáme pod gril, kým navrchu nezhnedne, asi 3 minúty.
Tami's version: use lactose-free half-and-half (lactose-free milk and cream).
Tamina verzia: použite bezlaktózovú zmes mlieka a smotany.

cat.en: Soak the salt cod for a full 24 hours in several changes of cold water; a shorter soak leaves the brandade too salty.
cat.sk: Solenú tresku namáčajte celých 24 hodín vo viackrát vymenenej studenej vode; pri kratšom namáčaní bude brandade príliš slaná.

src: Serious Eats — Sasha Marx — "Fritto Misto di Mare (Fried Mixed Seafood)"

en.v: Two rimmed baking sheets and two wire racks; Dutch oven; spider skimmer

sk.v: Dva plechy s okrajom a dve mriežky, liatinový hrniec, cedidlová naberačka

en.v: Like most fried foods, fritto misto is best enjoyed immediately.

sk.v: Ako väčšina vyprážaných jedál, aj fritto misto je najlepšie hneď.

c.t: Use shell-on (ideally head-on) shrimp: the shells protect the meat from overcooking, add flavour and fry into a crunchy, edible coating; fried heads are delicious too.
Smelt are a very good substitute for sardines and other small fish; they are usually sold cleaned (headless and gutted), also frozen.
Použite krevety v pancieri (najlepšie aj s hlavou): pancier chráni mäso pred prevarením, dodá chuť a vyprážaním sa zmení na chrumkavý jedlý obal; vyprážané hlavy sú tiež výborné.
Koruškovité rybky (smelt) sú veľmi dobrou náhradou sardiniek a iných malých rýb; zvyčajne sa predávajú očistené (bez hlavy a vypitvané), aj mrazené.

en.t: 455 g medium to large head-on shrimp or 340 g medium shell-on shrimp
1890 ml vegetable oil, for frying
310 g fine semolina flour (semola rimacinata) or all-purpose flour
70 g cornstarch
1/2 tsp (2 g) baking powder
Kosher salt
455 g cleaned squid, tubes sliced crosswise into 2 cm-thick rings, tentacles left whole
340 g smelt, cleaned
Lemon wedges, for serving

sk.t: 455 g stredné až veľké krevety s hlavou alebo 340 g stredné krevety v pancieri
1890 ml rastlinný olej, na vyprážanie
310 g jemná semolinová múka (semola rimacinata) alebo hladká múka
70 g kukuričný škrob
½ ČL (2 g) prášok do pečiva
hrubozrnná soľ
455 g očistené kalmáre, telá priečne nakrájané na 2 cm hrubé krúžky, chápadlá celé
340 g koruška (malé rybky), očistená
mesiačiky citróna, na podávanie

en.t: 1. Using kitchen shears or a sharp paring knife, cut through shrimp shells and devein shrimp without removing the shells. Pat dry with paper towels and set aside.

2. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 95 °C (fan 75 °C). Set a wire rack in a rimmed baking sheet and place a colander on top of the rack. Set a second wire rack in another rimmed baking sheet and line rack with paper towels. In a large Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat to 190 °C.

3. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, and baking powder until thoroughly combined. Pat squid dry with paper towels and transfer to dredge mixture. Toss to evenly coat, then gently shake off excess flour and transfer squid to colander set over wire rack. Shake colander to sift out any excess flour, then transfer squid in a single layer to wire rack. Repeat process with the smelt, followed by the shrimp.

4. Add shrimp to oil and fry until light golden brown, stirring occasionally to prevent shrimp from sticking together, 2 to 3 minutes. Using a spider skimmer or slotted spoon, transfer shrimp to prepared paper towel–lined rack, season lightly with salt, then transfer to oven to keep warm.

5. Return oil to 190 °C and add half the squid. Fry until golden brown, stirring occasionally to prevent pieces from sticking to each other, about 3 minutes. Transfer squid to rack with shrimp, season lightly with salt, and return to oven to keep warm. Repeat with remaining squid.

6. Return oil to 190 °C and add the smelt. Fry until smelt are pale golden and just cooked through, about 3 minutes. Transfer to rack with fried seafood and season lightly with salt. Transfer seafood to a serving platter lined with parchment or butcher paper and serve immediately with lemon wedges.

sk.t: 1. Kuchynskými nožnicami alebo ostrým malým nožom prestrihneme pancier kreviet a odstránime črevo bez odstránenia panciera. Osušíme papierovými utierkami a odložíme.

2. Rošt dáme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 95 °C (teplovzdušnú na 75 °C). Do plechu s okrajom vložíme mriežku a na ňu postavíme cedník. Do druhého plechu s okrajom vložíme druhú mriežku a vystelieme ju papierovými utierkami. Vo veľkom liatinovom hrnci zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni olej na 190 °C.

3. Medzitým vo veľkej mise metličkou dôkladne zmiešame múku, kukuričný škrob a kypriaci prášok do pečiva. Kalamáre osušíme papierovými utierkami a preložíme do obaľovacej zmesi. Premiešame, aby sa rovnomerne obalili, jemne striasieme prebytočnú múku a preložíme ich do cedníka nad mriežkou. Cedníkom potrasieme, aby sme preosiali prebytočnú múku, potom kalamáre rozložíme v jednej vrstve na mriežku. Postup zopakujeme s malými rybkami (koruškami) a potom s krevetami.

4. Krevety vložíme do oleja a vyprážame, kým nie sú svetlozlatohnedé, 2 až 3 minúty; občas premiešame, aby sa nezlepili. Cedidlovou naberačkou alebo dierovanou lyžicou ich preložíme na pripravenú mriežku s papierovými utierkami, zľahka osolíme a vložíme do rúry, aby zostali teplé.

5. Olej znova zohrejeme na 190 °C a pridáme polovicu kalamárov. Vyprážame dozlatista, asi 3 minúty; občas premiešame, aby sa kúsky nezlepili. Kalamáre preložíme na mriežku ku krevetám, zľahka osolíme a vrátime do rúry, aby zostali teplé. Zopakujeme so zvyšnými kalamármi.

6. Olej znova zohrejeme na 190 °C a pridáme rybky. Vyprážame, kým nie sú svetlozlatisté a práve hotové, asi 3 minúty. Preložíme na mriežku k ostatným vyprážaným plodom mora a zľahka osolíme. Všetko preložíme na servírovací tanier vystlaný papierom na pečenie alebo baliacim papierom a hneď podávame s mesiačikmi citróna.

en.v: instead of frying as in the method below, the dish can be made in the air fryer.

c.t: Oil: 1–2 tbsp oil, sprayed or brushed on (instead of the frying oil)
Air fryer: 200 °C: shrimp 5–7 min, squid and smelt 6–8 min, shaking halfway (preheat 3 min; don't crowd the basket — cook in batches)
Steps:
1. Prepare and dredge the seafood as in steps 1 and 3, then spray it all over with oil until no dry flour is visible.
2. Air-fry each kind separately in a single layer: shrimp for 5–7 minutes, squid and smelt for 6–8 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until golden and cooked through.
3. Keep warm in the oven at 95 °C (fan 75 °C), season with salt and serve with lemon wedges.

en.v: oven 220 °C (fan 200 °C) on a rack over a lined tray, about 1.5–2× the air-fryer time, turning halfway.

sk.v: teplovzdušná fritéza (vlastná úprava): namiesto vyprážania podľa postupu nižšie môžeme jedlo pripraviť v teplovzdušnej fritéze.

c.t: Olej: 1–2 PL oleja, nastriekaného alebo natretého štetcom (namiesto oleja na vyprážanie)
Teplovzdušná fritéza: 200 °C: krevety 5–7 min, kalamáre a gavúny 6–8 min, v polovici pretriasť (predhriať 3 min; kôš neprepĺňať — pripravovať po dávkach)
Postup:
1. Morské plody pripravíme a obalíme podľa krokov 1 a 3, potom ich zo všetkých strán postriekame olejom, kým nie je vidieť suchú múku.
2. Každý druh pečieme zvlášť v jednej vrstve: krevety 5–7 minút, kalamáre a gavúny 6–8 minút; v polovici kôš pretrasieme a pečieme, kým nie sú zlatisté a prepečené.
3. Udržiavame ich teplé v rúre pri 95 °C (teplovzdušnej 75 °C), osolíme a podávame s mesiačikmi citróna.

sk.v: rúra 220 °C (teplovzdušná 200 °C) na mriežke nad vystlaným plechom, asi 1,5–2-násobok času vo fritéze, v polovici obrátiť.

en.t: 9 tbsp (125 g) unsalted butter, cut into 9 pieces
905 g extra-large shrimp (about 46 to 55 per kg), peeled and deveined, shells reserved
3 onions, chopped
3 celery ribs, chopped
Salt and pepper
1180 ml water
8 garlic cloves (2 peeled and smashed, 6 minced)
1 tbsp (15 ml) peppercorns
3 bay leaves
2 sprigs fresh thyme, plus 1 tsp (5 ml) minced
60 g all-purpose flour
1 green bell pepper, stemmed, seeded, and chopped
1 tsp (5 ml) smoked paprika
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) cayenne pepper
1 (410 g) can diced tomatoes
3 scallions, sliced thin
2 tsp (10 ml) Worcestershire sauce
Cooked white rice
Hot sauce
Lemon wedges

1. Melt 1 tbsp (15 ml) butter in Dutch oven over medium heat. Add shrimp shells, 475 ml onion, 120 ml celery, and 1 tsp (5 ml) salt and cook, stirring occasionally, until shells are spotty brown, about 10 minutes. Add water, smashed garlic, peppercorns, bay leaves, and thyme sprigs and bring to boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes. Strain shrimp stock through fine-mesh strainer set over large bowl, pressing on solids to extract as much liquid as possible; discard solids. Wash and dry pot. (Stock can be refrigerated for 3 days or frozen for up to 1 month.)

2. Toast flour in now-empty pot over medium heat, stirring constantly, until just beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Whisk in remaining 8 tbsp (115 g) butter until melted and combined with flour. Continue to cook, whisking constantly, until deep brown, 4 to 6 minutes.

3. Add bell pepper, remaining onion, remaining celery, 1 tsp (5 ml) salt, and 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) pepper and cook, stirring often, until vegetables are softened, 10 to 12 minutes. Add paprika, cayenne, minced garlic, and minced thyme and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in tomatoes and their juice and cook until dry, about 1 minute. Slowly whisk in 945 ml shrimp stock until incorporated (reserve any remaining stock for another use). Bring to boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer until slightly thickened, about 25 minutes.

4. Season shrimp with salt and pepper, add to pot, and simmer until cooked through, about 5 minutes. Stir in scallions and Worcestershire. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve over rice with hot sauce and lemon wedges.

1. V liatinovom hrnci rozpustíme na strednom ohni 2 ČL (10 ml) masla. Pridáme pancier z kreviet, 475 ml cibule, 120 ml zeleru a 1 ČL (5 ml) soli a za občasného miešania opekáme, kým pancier miestami nezhnedne, asi 10 minút. Pridáme vodu, rozpučený cesnak, zrnká korenia, bobkové listy a vetvičky tymiánu a privedieme do varu. Oheň stlmíme na mierny, prikryjeme a mierne varíme 30 minút. Krevetový vývar precedíme cez jemné sitko postavené na veľkej mise a pevné časti pretlačíme, aby sme získali čo najviac tekutiny; pevné časti vyhodíme. Hrniec umyjeme a osušíme. (Vývar vydrží v chladničke 3 dni alebo v mrazničke najviac 1 mesiac.)

2. V prázdnom hrnci na strednom ohni za stáleho miešania opražíme múku, kým nezačne hnednúť, asi 5 minút. Všľaháme zvyšných 5⅔ PL (80 g) masla, kým sa neroztopí a nespojí s múkou. Za stáleho šľahania opekáme ďalej, kým zápražka nie je tmavohnedá, 4 až 6 minút.

3. Pridáme papriku, zvyšnú cibuľu, zvyšný zeler, 1 ČL (5 ml) soli a ½ ČL (2,5 ml) korenia a za častého miešania opekáme, kým zelenina nezmäkne, 10 až 12 minút. Pridáme mletú papriku, kajenské korenie, nasekaný cesnak a nasekaný tymian a opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 1 minútu. Vmiešame paradajky aj so šťavou a varíme, kým sa tekutina neodparí, asi 1 minútu. Pomaly všľaháme 945 ml krevetového vývaru (zvyšok vývaru odložíme na iné použitie). Privedieme do varu, oheň stlmíme na stredný až mierny a mierne varíme, kým omáčka mierne nezhustne, asi 25 minút.

4. Krevety osolíme, okoreníme, pridáme do hrnca a varíme, kým nie sú hotové, asi 5 minút. Vmiešame jarnú cibuľku a worcesterskú omáčku. Podľa chuti osolíme a okoreníme. Podávame na ryži so štipľavou omáčkou a mesiačikmi citróna.

c.t: Skip deveining if the shrimp have no dark vein; the vein can often be pulled out with tweezers from the head end instead of cutting down the back. The amount of lime juice depends on the tomato purée and ketchup used; adjust to taste.

en.t: 1. In a large bowl, toss shrimp with 1 tsp (3 g) kosher salt and baking soda until evenly coated. Transfer to refrigerator for 15 minutes.
2. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, stir together 4 tbsp (59 ml) lime juice with onion, tomato purée, ketchup, cilantro, orange juice, and jalapeño.

3. In a medium pot, combine 1890 ml cold water with remaining 2 tbsp (30 ml) lime juice and 2 tbsp (30 ml) salt. Add shrimp, set over medium-high heat, and cook, stirring occasionally, until temperature reaches 77 °C on an instant-read thermometer and shrimp are just cooked through; adjust heat to make sure temperature does not go over 77 °C.

4. Drain shrimp carefully, rinse under cold running water, then drain well. Cut shrimp into 1.5 cm pieces. Add shrimp to bowl with sauce and toss to combine. Taste, then add more lime juice if desired. Top with avocado and serve immediately with saltines and hot sauce.

sk.t: 1. Vo veľkej mise premiešame krevety s 1 ČL (3 g) hrubej soli a jedlou sódou, kým sa rovnomerne neobalia. Dáme na 15 minút do chladničky.
2. Medzitým v strednej mise zmiešame 4 PL (59 ml) limetkovej šťavy s cibuľou, paradajkovým pyré, kečupom, koriandrovou vňaťou, pomarančovou šťavou a jalapeňom.

3. V strednom hrnci zmiešame 1890 ml studenej vody so zvyšnými 2 PL (30 ml) limetkovej šťavy a 2 PL (30 ml) soli. Pridáme krevety, postavíme na stredne silný až silný oheň a za občasného miešania zohrievame, kým vpichový teplomer neukáže 77 °C a krevety nie sú práve hotové; oheň upravujeme tak, aby teplota neprekročila 77 °C.

4. Krevety opatrne scedíme, opláchneme pod studenou tečúcou vodou a dobre necháme odkvapkať. Nakrájame ich na kúsky veľké 1,5 cm. Pridáme ich do misy s omáčkou a premiešame. Ochutnáme a podľa chuti pridáme limetkovú šťavu. Navrch dáme avokádo a hneď podávame so slanými krekrami a štipľavou omáčkou.

c.t: Black sea bass, cod, hake or pollock can replace the haddock; fold thin tail-end fillets to get the right thickness. The dish is typically spicy; for a milder one, reduce the Aleppo pepper to 1 or 2 tsp. Tabil can be made at home (see "How to Make Tabil" on the source site). Serve with challah.

Tresku jednoškvrnnú môžete nahradiť morským ostriežom, treskou, merlúzou alebo treskou tmavou; tenké chvostové filety preložte, aby mali správnu hrúbku. Jedlo je zvyčajne pikantné; na jemnejšie znížte aleppské korenie na 1 alebo 2 ČL. Tabil si môžete pripraviť doma (pozri „How to Make Tabil“ na stránke zdroja). Podávajte s chalou.

en.t: 3 tbsp (44 ml) extra-virgin olive oil, plus extra for drizzling
1 onion, chopped fine
1 red bell pepper, stemmed, seeded, and chopped
1 jalapeño chile, stemmed, seeded, and minced
¾ tsp (4.5 g) table salt
59 ml tomato paste
6 garlic cloves, minced
1 tbsp (15 ml) tabil
1 tbsp (15 ml) ground dried Aleppo pepper
2 tsp (10 ml) paprika
¼ tsp (1.2 ml) pepper
355 ml water
680 g skinless haddock filets, 1.5–2 cm thick, cut into 7.5 cm pieces
285 g cherry tomatoes
120 ml chopped fresh cilantro
Lemon wedges

1. Heat oil in 30 cm skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Add onion, bell pepper, jalapeño, and salt and cook until vegetables are softened, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in tomato paste, garlic, tabil, Aleppo pepper, paprika, and pepper and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Stir in water, scraping up any browned bits, and bring to simmer. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until flavors meld, about 15 minutes.

2. Nestle haddock into sauce and spoon some of sauce over fish. Sprinkle tomatoes around haddock and return to simmer. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until fish flakes apart when gently prodded with paring knife and registers 55 °C, 5 to 7 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle with cilantro and drizzle with extra oil. Serve with lemon wedges.

c.t: 1. Heat oil in 30 cm skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Add onion, bell pepper, jalapeño, and salt and cook until vegetables are softened, 5 to 7 minutes. Stir in tomato paste, garlic, tabil, Aleppo pepper, paprika, and pepper and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Stir in water, scraping up any browned bits, and bring to simmer. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until flavors meld, about 15 minutes.

2. Nestle haddock into sauce and spoon some of sauce over fish. Sprinkle tomatoes around haddock and return to simmer. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until fish flakes apart when gently prodded with paring knife and registers 55 °C, 5 to 7 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle with cilantro and drizzle with extra oil. Serve with lemon wedges.

1. V panvici s priemerom 30 cm zohrejeme na strednom ohni olej, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme cibuľu, papriku, jalapeño a soľ a dusíme, kým zelenina nezmäkne, 5 až 7 minút. Vmiešame paradajkový pretlak, cesnak, tabil, papriku z Aleppa, mletú papriku a korenie a opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 30 sekúnd. Vmiešame vodu, zoškrabeme pripečené zvyšky a privedieme do mierneho varu. Oheň stlmíme na mierny, prikryjeme a dusíme, kým sa chute nespoja, asi 15 minút.

2. Do omáčky vložíme tresku (haddock) a polejeme ju trochou omáčky. Okolo ryby rozsypeme paradajky a znova privedieme do mierneho varu. Oheň stlmíme na mierny, prikryjeme a dusíme, kým sa ryba pri jemnom dotyku malým nožom nerozpadá na lupienky a nemá vnútri 55 °C, 5 až 7 minút. Podľa chuti osolíme a okoreníme. Posypeme koriandrovou vňaťou a pokvapkáme ďalším olejom. Podávame s mesiačikmi citróna.

en.t: 1 tsp (5 ml) whole coriander seeds

1 tsp (5 ml) ground turmeric
3 medium cloves garlic (15 g)
One 2.5 cm knob peeled ginger (15 g), sliced into coins
3 tbsp (45 ml) neutral oil, such as vegetable oil, divided
3 small Japanese eggplants (300 g), quartered lengthwise and cut into 7.5 cm lengths
1 tsp (5 ml) whole mustard seeds
1 tsp (5 ml) whole fenugreek seeds
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) whole cumin seeds
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) whole fennel seeds
1 small yellow onion (113 g), thinly sliced
Kosher salt
2 large garden tomatoes (400 g), cored and diced
25 curry leaves, woody stems removed
1 tbsp (15 ml) tamarind paste
454 g fish heads (from about 2 large fish, preferable a large oily fish like mackerel or salmon), split in half lengthways and gills removed
10 large okra pods (140 g), stem ends trimmed and pods sliced in half on a bias crosswise
3 small green chiles, such as serranos or green bird's eye, stemmed, sliced in half lengthwise, and seeded
1 tsp (4 g) light brown sugar, turbinado sugar, or granulated sugar
120 ml full-fat coconut milk
Cooked white rice or warm flatbreads, for serving

1. For the Curry Powder: In a dry skillet, toast coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, black peppercorns, and white peppercorns over medium heat until they darken slightly and become fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and transfer the toasted spices to a mortar or spice grinder. Allow spices to cool for 1 minute, then grind spices until finely ground. Transfer to a small bowl and stir in the chile powder and turmeric. Set aside.
2. For the Curry: Using the same mortar (no need to wipe it out), pound the garlic and ginger into a smooth paste.

3. In a large sauté pan or medium Dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp (15 ml) vegetable oil over medium-high until shimmering. Add the eggplant in a single layer and cook until first side is lightly browned, about 2 minutes. Flip the eggplant and cook until second side is lightly browned, about 2 minutes (we’re not looking to fully cook the eggplant; we just want to get some color on them). Transfer to a plate and set aside.

4. Add the remaining 2 tbsp (30 ml) vegetable oil to the same sauté pan or Dutch oven and reduce heat to medium-low. Add the mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, cumin seeds, and fennel seeds and cook, stirring occasionally, until the spices are fragrant and the mustard seeds begin to sputter, 30 seconds.

5. Stir in the sliced onions, season with salt, and cook, stirring often, until the onion begins to soften, 6 to 7 minutes. Stir in the garlic and ginger paste along with the diced tomatoes, and cook until the tomatoes begin to break down into a sauce, about 10 minutes.
6. Meanwhile, slowly add 120 ml water to the curry powder while whisking to form a paste. Stir the curry paste into the broken-down tomatoes and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes.

7. Add the curry leaves to the skillet and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add tamarind paste and 475 ml water, then stir well, making sure to scrape up any bits stuck to the bottom of the skillet.

8. Add the fish head halves, reserved eggplant, sliced okra, and sliced green chiles, making sure the liquid in the skillet comes at least 2/3 of the way up the sides of the fish heads; add more water if necessary. Add a large pinch of salt and bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then cover with a lid, reduce heat to low, and simmer until the fish heads and okra are fully cooked, about 20 minutes.
9. Stir in the sugar and coconut milk and season with salt. Simmer for another 5 minutes, then remove from heat. Serve warm with rice or flatbread.

1. **NA KARI KORENIE:** Na suchej panvici opražíme na strednom ohni koriandrové semienka, celú rímsku rascu (kmín), fenikel, zrnká čierneho a bieleho korenia, kým mierne nestmavnú a nezavoňajú, asi 1 minútu. Odstavíme z ohňa a opražené koreniny preložíme do mažiara alebo mlynčeka na korenie. Necháme ich 1 minútu chladnúť, potom ich zomelieme najemno. Preložíme do malej misky a vmiešame mleté čili a kurkumu. Odložíme.
2. **NA KARI:** V tom istom mažiari (netreba ho vytierať) roztlčieme cesnak a zázvor na hladkú pastu.

3. Vo veľkej panvici alebo strednom liatinovom hrnci zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni 1¾ ČL (9 ml) rastlinného oleja, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme baklažán v jednej vrstve a opekáme, kým prvá strana zľahka nezhnedne, asi 2 minúty. Obrátime a opekáme, kým zľahka nezhnedne aj druhá strana, asi 2 minúty (baklažán nechceme úplne uvariť, len ho trochu opiecť). Preložíme na tanier a odložíme.

4. Do tej istej panvice alebo hrnca pridáme zvyšné 1¼ PL (18 ml) rastlinného oleja a oheň stlmíme na stredný až mierny. Pridáme horčičné semienka, senovku grécku, celú rímsku rascu a fenikel a za občasného miešania opekáme, kým koreniny nezavoňajú a horčičné semienka nezačnú praskať, 30 sekúnd.

5. Vmiešame nakrájanú cibuľu, osolíme a za častého miešania opekáme, kým cibuľa nezačne mäknúť, 6 až 7 minút. Vmiešame cesnakovo-zázvorovú pastu spolu s nakrájanými paradajkami a dusíme, kým sa paradajky nezačnú rozpadať na omáčku, asi 10 minút.
6. Medzitým ku kari koreniu za šľahania pomaly prilievame 120 ml vody, aby vznikla pasta. Kari pastu vmiešame do rozvarených paradajok a varíme, kým nezhustne, asi 5 minút.
7. Pridáme kari listy a opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 1 minútu. Pridáme tamarindovú pastu a 475 ml vody, dobre premiešame a zoškrabeme všetko, čo sa prilepilo na dno.

8. Pridáme polovice rybích hláv, odložený baklažán, nakrájanú okru a nakrájané zelené čili papričky; tekutina musí siahať aspoň do dvoch tretín výšky rybích hláv, podľa potreby dolejeme vodu. Pridáme veľkú štipku soli a na stredne silnom až silnom ohni privedieme do varu, potom prikryjeme pokrievkou, oheň stlmíme na mierny a dusíme, kým rybie hlavy aj okra nie sú úplne hotové, asi 20 minút.
9. Vmiešame cukor a kokosové mlieko a osolíme. Dusíme ďalších 5 minút, potom odstavíme z ohňa. Podávame teplé s ryžou alebo plackami.

c.t: True sole (such as Dover sole) is hard to find and expensive; other thin white flatfish fillets work, including grey sole, Petrale sole, lemon sole and flounder. 170 g fillets give 4 perfect portions; smaller fillets can be shared out.
Clarified butter browns the fish without the risk of burnt milk solids while keeping a buttery flavour; without it, use a neutral oil such as vegetable or canola.

Pravý jazyk morský (napríklad Dover) sa ťažko zháňa a je drahý; fungujú aj iné tenké filety z bielych platesovitých rýb vrátane jazyka sivého, jazyka Petrale, jazyka citrónového a platesy. Filety po 170 g dajú 4 dokonalé porcie; menšie filety rozdeľte medzi stolujúcich.
Prepustené maslo rybu opečie bez rizika pripálenia mliečnych bielkovín a zachová maslovú chuť; bez neho použite neutrálny olej, napríklad rastlinný alebo repkový.

en.t: All-purpose flour, for dredging (about 60 g)
680 g thin boneless, skinless sole or other white-fleshed fish fillets
Kosher salt
4 tbsp (60 g) homemade or store-bought clarified butter, plus more if needed
6 tbsp (90 g) unsalted butter, cut into 1-tbsp pieces
1 lemon, cut into wedges, plus more for serving
1 1/2 tbsp (8 g) flat-leaf parsley leaves and tender stems

1. In a wide, shallow bowl or platter, spread flour in an even layer. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Season fish fillets all over with salt. Working with one piece of fish at a time, dredge fillets in flour, shaking off excess. Transfer to prepared baking sheet.

2. Working in two or more batches so that you can comfortably fit fillets in one layer without crowding, heat 2 tbsp (30 g) clarified butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add fish, presentation side down, and cook until well browned on on first side, 3 to 4 minutes (it's okay if the fillets are mostly cooked through at this point). Using two spatulas, if necessary, carefully flip each fillet and continue cooking until just cooked through and flesh is opaque throughout, 30 seconds to 1 minute. Carefully transfer fish, well-browned side up, to a serving platter or plates and keep warm. Repeat with remaining fillets and clarified butter, using 2 tbsp (28 g) of clarified butter per batch.

3. Wipe out skillet. Add unsalted butter to skillet, set over medium-high heat and cook until butter is melted and foamy. Continue to cook, swirling pan, until milk solids in butter turn a deep hazelnut brown, 1 to 2 minutes longer.
4. While butter is browning, squeeze lemon juice all over fish, then sprinkle all over with parsley.

5. When butter is browned, immediately spoon it all over the fish; it should bubble and foam as soon as it hits the fish (this is very fun to do tableside for your guests and adds to the experience). Serve immediately with additional lemon on the side.

c.t: 1. In a wide, shallow bowl or platter, spread flour in an even layer. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Season fish fillets all over with salt. Working with one piece of fish at a time, dredge fillets in flour, shaking off excess. Transfer to prepared baking sheet.

2. Working in two or more batches so that you can comfortably fit fillets in one layer without crowding, heat 1⅓ tbsp (21 g) clarified butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add fish, presentation side down, and cook until well browned on on first side, 3 to 4 minutes (it's okay if the fillets are mostly cooked through at this point). Using two spatulas, if necessary, carefully flip each fillet and continue cooking until just cooked through and flesh is opaque throughout, 30 seconds to 1 minute. Carefully transfer fish, well-browned side up, to a serving platter or plates and keep warm. Repeat with remaining fillets and clarified butter, using 1⅓ tbsp (20 g) of clarified butter per batch.

3. Wipe out skillet. Add unsalted butter to skillet, set over medium-high heat and cook until butter is melted and foamy. Continue to cook, swirling pan, until milk solids in butter turn a deep hazelnut brown, 1 to 2 minutes longer.
4. While butter is browning, squeeze lemon juice all over fish, then sprinkle all over with parsley.

5. When butter is browned, immediately spoon it all over the fish; it should bubble and foam as soon as it hits the fish (this is very fun to do tableside for your guests and adds to the experience). Serve immediately with additional lemon on the side.

1. Do širokej plytkej misy alebo na tanier rozsypeme múku v rovnomernej vrstve. Plech s okrajom vystelieme papierom na pečenie. Rybie filety zo všetkých strán osolíme. Po jednom ich obalíme v múke a prebytok striasieme. Preložíme na pripravený plech.

2. Pracujeme v dvoch alebo viacerých dávkach, aby sa filety pohodlne zmestili v jednej vrstve: vo veľkej nepriľnavej panvici zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni 1⅓ PL (21 g) prepusteného masla, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Vložíme rybu krajšou stranou nadol a opekáme, kým prvá strana pekne nezhnedne, 3 až 4 minúty (nevadí, ak je ryba v tejto chvíli už takmer hotová). Podľa potreby dvoma obracačkami opatrne obrátime každý filet a opekáme, kým nie je práve hotový a mäso celé nepriehľadné, 30 sekúnd až 1 minútu. Rybu opatrne preložíme opečenou stranou nahor na servírovací tanier alebo taniere a udržiavame teplú. Zopakujeme so zvyšnými filetmi a prepusteným maslom, na každú dávku použijeme 1⅓ PL (20 g) prepusteného masla.

3. Panvicu vytrieme. Dáme do nej nesolené maslo, postavíme na stredne silný až silný oheň a zohrievame, kým sa maslo neroztopí a nezačne peniť. Za krúženia panvicou zohrievame ďalej, kým mliečne bielkoviny v masle nezískajú sýtu orieškovohnedú farbu, ešte 1 až 2 minúty.
4. Kým maslo hnedne, rybu celú pokvapkáme citrónovou šťavou a posypeme petržlenovou vňaťou.
5. Keď maslo zhnedne, hneď ním lyžicou polejeme celú rybu; po dopade na rybu by malo bublať a peniť (veľmi efektné, keď to robíme pred hosťami pri stole). Hneď podávame s ďalším citrónom.

1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 230 °C (fan 210 °C). Cut 4 large pieces of aluminum foil.
2. In small bowl, combine thyme, lemon zest, salt, and pepper. Place 1 fillet on 1 side of each piece of foil. Sprinkle thyme mixture evenly over fillets and top with butter.
3. Fold empty side of foil over cod. Fold up edges of foil and pinch together to create sealed packet. Transfer packets to rimmed baking sheet.
4. Place baking sheet in oven and bake until cod registers 60 °C on instant-read thermometer, 12 to 15 minutes.
5. Use oven mitts to remove baking sheet from oven and place on cooling rack. Transfer packets to plates and carefully open. Serve with lemon wedges.

plátky citróna, ošúpané strúčiky cesnaku, ošúpané plátky zázvoru a/alebo vetvičky čerstvých byliniek (napr. petržlen, kôpor, oregano, tymián alebo estragón) na plnenie
extra panenský olivový olej na potretie a pokvapkanie

en.t: 1. Preheat oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C) and set rack to middle position. Line a rimed baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, stir together salt and water until thoroughly mixed and salt is damp but not soggy.
2. Stuff fish cavity with aromatics of your choice, then lightly brush olive oil all over the fish on both sides.
3. Spread about one-third of the salt mixture on the prepared baking sheet, covering an area just a little larger than the shape of the fish.
4. Set fish on salt bed. If using a leave-in probe thermometer, insert it into thickest part of fish (if using a regular instant-read thermometer, see next step).

5. Fully cover fish with the remaining salt, making sure to pack salt all around the fish in an even layer about 1.5 cm thick. If using an instant-read digital thermometer, insert the probe of the thermometer into the salt to form a narrow hole leading to the thickest part of the fish (you will use this hole after the salt hardens to access the fish and check its temperature). Roast fish until center of the thickest part of the flesh registers 55 °C, about 20 minutes for a 455 g fish and 30 minutes for a 905 g fish. Let rest 5 minutes.

6. Using a knife, carefully cut into salt crust along the length of the fish on the side near its belly, then gently crack open salt to uncover fish. Being careful not to get the salt crust mixed into the flesh, remove and discard skin, then fillet the cooked fish and transfer to a platter. Serve.

sk.t: 1. Rúru rozohrejeme na 205 °C (teplovzdušnú na 185 °C) a rošt dáme do stredu. Plech s okrajom vystelieme papierom na pečenie. Vo veľkej mise dôkladne zmiešame soľ s vodou, kým nie je soľ vlhká, ale nie rozmočená.
2. Brušnú dutinu ryby naplníme aromatickými prísadami podľa výberu, potom rybu z oboch strán zľahka potrieme olivovým olejom.
3. Asi tretinu soľnej zmesi rozotrieme na pripravený plech na ploche o niečo väčšej, ako je tvar ryby.
4. Rybu položíme na soľné lôžko. Ak používame teplomer so sondou, ktorá zostáva v mäse, zapichneme ju do najhrubšej časti ryby (pri obyčajnom vpichovom teplomere pozri ďalší krok).

5. Rybu úplne zakryjeme zvyšnou soľou a dookola ju natlačíme v rovnomernej vrstve hrubej asi 1,5 cm. Pri digitálnom vpichovom teplomere zapichneme jeho sondu do soli, aby vznikol úzky otvor vedúci k najhrubšej časti ryby (týmto otvorom sa po stuhnutí soli dostaneme k rybe a skontrolujeme teplotu). Rybu pečieme, kým stred najhrubšej časti nemá 55 °C, asi 20 minút pri rybe s hmotnosťou 455 g a 30 minút pri rybe s hmotnosťou 905 g. Necháme 5 minút odpočívať.

6. Nožom opatrne narežeme soľnú kôru po dĺžke ryby na strane pri bruchu, potom soľ jemne rozlomíme a rybu odkryjeme. Dávame pozor, aby sa soľná kôra nedostala do mäsa; kožu stiahneme a vyhodíme, potom upečenú rybu vyfiletujeme a preložíme na tanier. Podávame.

en.t: 4 nori sheets (11 g)
1 recipe sumeshi (vinegared sushi rice; see sushi rice, chapter 09)
280 g assorted fillings cut into long strips no more than 1.5 cm wide (raw salmon or tuna, cucumber, avocado, pickles, etc)
wasabi, soy, and pickled ginger for serving (optional)

sk.t: 4 plátky nori (11 g)
1 dávka sumeshi (octom ochutená ryža na sushi; pozri ryža na sushi, kapitola 09)
280 g rôzne plnky nakrájané na dlhé pásiky široké najviac 1,5 cm (surový losos alebo tuniak, uhorka, avokádo, nakladaná zelenina a pod.)
wasabi, sójová omáčka a nakladaný zázvor na podávanie (nepovinné)

en.t: 1. Over a gas flame or in an oven heated to 205 °C (fan 185 °C), toast the nori sheets until pliable, about 5 seconds.

2. For Hosomaki Rolls (Thin rolls with 1 ingredient): Using kitchen shears or with a sharp knife on a cutting board, split the nori sheets evenly in half, cutting across the vertical lines that run along it.

3. Lay 1 nori sheet on a bamboo mat lined up 2.5 cm away from the edge closest to you. Keep the shiny side of the nori facing down and the indentations running vertically. (For easier clean-up, cover the mat in plastic wrap.) Moisten your hands with water and gently spread about 150 g of sumeshi evenly along the nori sheet, taking care not to compact the rice, and leaving a 1.5 cm boarder along the top and bottom of the nori sheet. Place your chosen filling along the lower third of the nori. Do not overstuff.

4. For Futomaki Rolls (Larger rolls with 2 or more ingredients): Lay 1 full nori sheet on a bamboo mat lined up 2.5 cm away from the edge closest to you. Keep the shiny side of the nori facing down and the indentations running vertically. (For easier clean-up, cover the mat in plastic wrap.) Moisten your hands with water and gently spread about 300 g of sumeshi evenly along the nori sheet, taking care not to compact the rice, and leaving a 5 cm boarder along the top edge. Place your chosen filings along the lower third of the nori. Do not overstuff.

5. To Roll Up the Makizushi: Slip your thumbs underneath the edge of the bamboo matt that's closest to you. Use your thumbs to lift the mat and flip the edge of the nori and rice over the filling, using your remaining fingers to press the filling toward you. Pull the mat foward, rolling the nori and rice around the filling. Dip a finger in water and run along the top exposed edge of the nori. Continue rolling to seal. Pull the matt over the roll and press gently to compress the roll.

6. With a sharp knife, cut the roll in half crosswise, lay the two halfs next to each other and slice into six even pieces. Allow the roll to rest about 2 minutes before serving with soy, wasabi, and ginger, if desired.

sk.t: 1. Plátky nori opečieme nad plynovým plameňom alebo v rúre vyhriatej na 205 °C (teplovzdušnej na 185 °C), kým nie sú ohybné, asi 5 sekúnd.
2. **NA HOSOMAKI (TENKÉ ROLKY S 1 PRÍSADOU):** Kuchynskými nožnicami alebo ostrým nožom na doske rozdelíme plátky nori na polovice, priečne na zvislé čiary, ktoré po nich vedú.

3. Na bambusovú podložku položíme 1 plátok nori 2,5 cm od okraja bližšie k nám. Lesklá strana nori je dole a ryhy idú zvislo. (Na ľahšie čistenie podložku obalíme fóliou.) Ruky navlhčíme vodou a na plátok nori jemne rovnomerne rozotrieme asi 150 g sushi ryže (sumeshi); ryžu neutláčame a hore aj dole necháme 1,5 cm voľný okraj. Vybranú plnku rozložíme v dolnej tretine nori. Neplníme príliš.

4. **NA FUTOMAKI (VÄČŠIE ROLKY S 2 A VIAC PRÍSADAMI):** Na bambusovú podložku položíme 1 celý plátok nori 2,5 cm od okraja bližšie k nám. Lesklá strana nori je dole a ryhy idú zvislo. (Na ľahšie čistenie podložku obalíme fóliou.) Ruky navlhčíme vodou a na plátok nori jemne rovnomerne rozotrieme asi 300 g sushi ryže; ryžu neutláčame a pri hornom okraji necháme 5 cm voľných. Vybrané plnky rozložíme v dolnej tretine nori. Neplníme príliš.

5. **ROLOVANIE MAKIZUSHI:** Palce vsunieme pod okraj bambusovej podložky bližšie k nám. Palcami podložku nadvihneme a preklopíme okraj nori s ryžou cez plnku, ostatnými prstami pritom pridržiavame plnku k sebe. Podložku posúvame dopredu a nori s ryžou rolujeme okolo plnky. Prst namočíme do vody a prejdeme ním po hornom voľnom okraji nori. Rolujeme ďalej, aby sa rolka uzavrela. Podložku preložíme cez rolku a jemne pritlačíme, aby sa rolka spevnila.

6. Ostrým nožom rolku priečne rozkrojíme na polovice, obe polovice položíme vedľa seba a nakrájame na šesť rovnakých kúskov. Rolku necháme pred podávaním asi 2 minúty odpočívať a podľa chuti podávame so sójovou omáčkou, wasabi a zázvorom.

en.t: Kosher salt
1 (900 g) skin-on sushi-grade salmon fillet, pin bones removed by fishmonger
1 tsp (5 ml) caraway seeds
1 tsp (5 ml) coriander seeds
40 g kosher salt (about 4 tbsp), plus more for washing salmon
15 g sugar (about 1 tbsp)
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) freshly ground white pepper or black pepper
2 large bunches dill
3 tbsp (45 ml) distilled white vinegar
2 tbsp (30 ml) roughly chopped dill fronds
5 tbsp (75 ml) Dijon mustard
1 tbsp (15 g) sugar
60 ml canola or vegetable oil
Freshly ground black pepper
Sliced pumpernickel bread, for serving
1. Fill a large bowl with cold water and add enough salt to make it taste like the sea. Add salmon and let stand 10 minutes.
2. In a skillet, toast caraway and coriander seeds over high heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Transfer to a spice grinder or mortar and pestle and grind finely.
3. In a small bowl, stir together salt, sugar, ground caraway and coriander seeds, and white or black pepper until thoroughly combined.
4. Remove salmon from bath and pat dry with paper towels. On a work surface, turn salmon skin side up and sprinkle about half of salt mixture all over, rubbing in with fingers.

5. Arrange half of dill all over the bottom of a baking dish large enough to hold salmon. Set salmon skin side down on bed of dill. Rub remaining salt mixture all over top and sides of salmon, then top with remaining dill. Cover salmon with plastic, then top with a weight (such as a smaller baking dish or plate with cans of beans on top). Refrigerate for 1 day.

6. After 1 day, unpack salmon and turn skin side up. Re-pack with dill, cover with plastic, and set weight back on top. 1. Veľkú misu naplníme studenou vodou a pridáme toľko soli, aby chutila ako more. Vložíme lososa a necháme 10 minút postáť.
2. Na panvici opražíme na silnom ohni za stáleho miešania rascu a koriandrové semienka, kým nezavoňajú, asi 1 minútu. Preložíme do mlynčeka na korenie alebo mažiara a zomelieme najemno.
3. V malej miske dôkladne zmiešame soľ, cukor, mletú rascu, mletý koriander a biele alebo čierne korenie.
4. Lososa vyberieme z kúpeľa a osušíme papierovými utierkami. Na pracovnej ploche ho otočíme kožou nahor, posypeme asi polovicou soľnej zmesi a prstami ju vtrieme.

5. Polovicu kôpru rozložíme po dne zapekacej misy dosť veľkej na lososa. Lososa položíme kožou nadol na kôprové lôžko. Zvyšnú soľnú zmes vtrieme do vrchu a bokov lososa a navrch dáme zvyšný kôpor. Lososa prikryjeme fóliou a zaťažíme (napríklad menšou zapekacou misou alebo tanierom s plechovkami fazule navrchu). Dáme na 1 deň do chladničky.

6. Po 1 dni lososa rozbalíme a otočíme kožou nahor. Znova obložíme kôprom, prikryjeme fóliou a zaťažíme. Necháme v chladničke, kým sa losos dostatočne nenaloží, 1 deň pre jemnejšie naloženie alebo 2 dni pre o niečo výraznejšie (mäso bude o trochu pevnejšie a slanšie).

7. **NA OMÁČKU:** Pred podávaním pripravíme omáčku. V mixéri, mini kuchynskom robote alebo ponorným mixérom spojíme ocot s nasekaným kôprom, horčicou a cukrom a mixujeme, kým nie je kôpor veľmi jemne nasekaný. Pridáme olej a mixujeme, kým nevznikne hladká omáčka. Okoreníme.

8. Lososa rozbalíme, zoškrabeme kôpor a položíme ho na pracovnú plochu. Veľmi ostrým nožom na krájanie nakrájame gravlax šikmo na tenké plátky. Poukladáme ich na plátky celozrnného ražného chleba (pumpernickel) a pokvapkáme omáčkou. Podávame. Pevne zabalený vo fólii vydrží gravlax po naložení v chladničke približne 5 dní.

en.t: 455 g fresh lump or jumbo lump crab meat, picked over
2 tbsp (30 ml) mayonnaise
2 tbsp (30 ml) chopped chives, tarragon, parsley, or a mix (optional)
2 large eggs, divided
75 g panko-style bread crumbs
3 tbsp (44 ml) canola or vegetable oil
3 tbsp (42 g) unsalted butter
Kosher salt
1 recipe tartar sauce (see Tartar sauce, chapter 17) or lemon wedges, for serving
1. In a large bowl, combine crab, mayonnaise, herbs (if using), and 1 egg. Using a flexible spatula, fold gently until combined, being careful not to break up any large lumps of crab.

2. On a work surface, place a 30 × 46 cm sheet of aluminum foil with the short end parallel to the edge of the surface. Transfer crab mixture to foil, about 10 cm from bottom of foil, and form into a rough log about 15 cm wide.

3. Carefully lift bottom edge of foil and lift it over the crab log. Roll the log away from you until it is completely wrapped in foil, then twist the ends to form a tight roll about 15–20 cm wide and 7.5–10 cm in diameter. Place log on a tray or plate and transfer to the freezer until lightly stiff, 20 to 25 minutes.

4. Remove the log from the freezer and using a sharp chef's knife, slice off one of the twisted ends. Remove crab mixture from inside twisted end and reserve. Slice log into 4 or 6 individual disks, about 4 cm thick each. Transfer disks (with their foil) to a rimmed baking sheet cut-side down. Combine any crab mixture removed from twisted ends and form into a free-form crab cake and place on tray along with foil-wrapped disks. Transfer to freezer until disks are relatively stiff, about 20 to 25 minutes.

5. In a small bowl, beat remaining egg until homogenous. In a second small bowl, place bread crumbs. Working one crab disk at a time, lift by grasping the foil-lined edges. Dip one cut surface in egg, then in bread crumbs, pressing down gently to adhere. Return to baking sheet, cut side down and repeat with remaining disks (including free-form disk).

6. Adjust oven rack to 15 cm below broiler element and preheat broiler to high. In a large cast iron skillet, heat oil and butter over medium heat until foaming subsides. Add crab cakes, breaded side down and cook, swirling occasionally, for 3 minutes. Carefully peel off foil from each cake using your fingertips, without lifting the cakes; discard foil. Continue cooking, swirling pan occasionally until underside of crab cakes is light golden brown, about 2 minutes longer (check underneath with a thin flexible metal spatula, but be careful not to break crab cakes, they will be fragile).

7. Grasp the handle of the pan and tilt it towards you so the fat collects in the bottom. Use a spoon to baste each cake with fat, making sure that it is completely coated, then transfer skillet to broiler. Broil until light golden brown on top and crab cakes are cooked through (an instant-read thermometer inserted into their center should register 65 to 70 °C), about 5 minutes. Remove from oven. Transfer crab cakes breaded-side-down to a paper towel-lined plate. Flip crab cakes and season with salt. Serve immediately with tartar sauce or lemon wedges.

c.t: 1. In a large bowl, combine crab, mayonnaise, herbs (if using), and 1 egg. Using a flexible spatula, fold gently until combined, being careful not to break up any large lumps of crab.

2. On a work surface, place a 30 × 46 cm sheet of aluminum foil with the short end parallel to the edge of the surface. Transfer crab mixture to foil, about 10 cm from bottom of foil, and form into a rough log about 15 cm wide.

3. Carefully lift bottom edge of foil and lift it over the crab log. Roll the log away from you until it is completely wrapped in foil, then twist the ends to form a tight roll about 15–20 cm wide and 7.5–10 cm in diameter. Place log on a tray or plate and transfer to the freezer until lightly stiff, 20 to 25 minutes.

4. Remove the log from the freezer and using a sharp chef's knife, slice off one of the twisted ends. Remove crab mixture from inside twisted end and reserve. Slice log into 4 or 6 individual disks, about 4 cm thick each. Transfer disks (with their foil) to a rimmed baking sheet cut-side down. Combine any crab mixture removed from twisted ends and form into a free-form crab cake and place on tray along with foil-wrapped disks. Transfer to freezer until disks are relatively stiff, about 20 to 25 minutes.

5. In a small bowl, beat remaining egg until homogenous. In a second small bowl, place bread crumbs. Working one crab disk at a time, lift by grasping the foil-lined edges. Dip one cut surface in egg, then in bread crumbs, pressing down gently to adhere. Return to baking sheet, cut side down and repeat with remaining disks (including free-form disk).

6. Adjust oven rack to 15 cm below broiler element and preheat broiler to high. In a large cast iron skillet, heat oil and butter over medium heat until foaming subsides. Add crab cakes, breaded side down and cook, swirling occasionally, for 3 minutes. Carefully peel off foil from each cake using your fingertips, without lifting the cakes; discard foil. Continue cooking, swirling pan occasionally until underside of crab cakes is light golden brown, about 2 minutes longer (check underneath with a thin flexible metal spatula, but be careful not to break crab cakes, they will be fragile).

7. Grasp the handle of the pan and tilt it towards you so the fat collects in the bottom. Use a spoon to baste each cake with fat, making sure that it is completely coated, then transfer skillet to broiler. Broil until light golden brown on top and crab cakes are cooked through (an instant-read thermometer inserted into their center should register 65 to 70 °C), about 5 minutes. Remove from oven. Transfer crab cakes breaded-side-down to a paper towel-lined plate. Flip crab cakes and season with salt. Serve immediately with tartar sauce or lemon wedges.
1. Vo veľkej mise zmiešame krabie mäso, majonézu, bylinky (ak ich používame) a 1 vajce. Ohybnou stierkou jemne premiešame, kým sa nespoja; dávame pozor, aby sme nerozbili väčšie kúsky krabieho mäsa.

2. Na pracovnú plochu položíme hárok alobalu 30 × 46 cm kratšou stranou rovnobežne s okrajom plochy. Krabiu zmes preložíme na alobal asi 10 cm od spodného okraja a vytvarujeme hrubý valec široký asi 15 cm.

3. Spodný okraj alobalu opatrne nadvihneme a preložíme cez krabí valec. Valec rolujeme od seba, kým nie je celý zabalený v alobale, potom konce pretočíme, aby vznikla pevná rolka dlhá asi 15 – 20 cm s priemerom 7,5 – 10 cm. Valec položíme na podnos alebo tanier a dáme do mrazničky, kým mierne nestuhne, 20 až 25 minút.

4. Valec vyberieme z mrazničky a ostrým kuchárskym nožom odrežeme jeden pretočený koniec. Krabiu zmes z pretočeného konca vyberieme a odložíme. Valec nakrájame na 4 alebo 6 kotúčov, každý hrubý asi 4 cm. Kotúče (aj s alobalom) preložíme na plech s okrajom reznou stranou nadol. Krabiu zmes z pretočených koncov spojíme, vytvarujeme z nej ručne placku a položíme ju na plech ku kotúčom v alobale. Dáme do mrazničky, kým kotúče pomerne nestuhnú, asi 20 až 25 minút.

5. V malej miske rozšľaháme zvyšné vajce dohladka. Do druhej malej misky dáme strúhanku. Po jednom kotúči ho uchopíme za okraje s alobalom. Jednu reznú plochu namočíme do vajca, potom do strúhanky a jemne pritlačíme, aby držala. Vrátime na plech reznou stranou nadol a zopakujeme so zvyšnými kotúčmi (aj s ručne tvarovanou plackou).

6. Rošt nastavíme 15 cm pod špirálu grilu a gril rozohrejeme na najvyšší stupeň. Vo veľkej liatinovej panvici zohrejeme na strednom ohni olej s maslom, kým neprestane peniť. Vložíme placky obalenou stranou nadol a opekáme, občas panvicou zakrúžime, 3 minúty. Z každej placky končekmi prstov opatrne stiahneme alobal bez toho, aby sme placky nadvihli; alobal vyhodíme. Opekáme ďalej, občas panvicou zakrúžime, kým spodok placiek nie je svetlozlatohnedý, ešte asi 2 minúty (skontrolujeme tenkou ohybnou kovovou obracačkou, ale opatrne, placky sú krehké).

7. Chytíme rukoväť panvice a nakloníme ju k sebe, aby sa tuk zhromaždil na spodku. Lyžicou polievame každú placku tukom, kým nie je celá obalená, potom panvicu preložíme pod gril. Grilujeme, kým placky navrchu nie sú svetlozlatohnedé a vnútri hotové (vpichový teplomer v strede by mal ukazovať 65 až 70 °C), asi 5 minút. Vyberieme z rúry. Placky preložíme obalenou stranou nadol na tanier vystlaný papierovými utierkami. Obrátime ich a osolíme. Hneď podávame s tatárskou omáčkou alebo mesiačikmi citróna.

cat.sk: Spojiva použite čo najmenej; čerstvé krabie mäso spojené len trochou strúhanky má najlepšiu štruktúru a najčistejšiu chuť.

1. Grind chiles, coconut, coriander, cumin, turmeric, garlic, and ginger in a spice grinder or blender until very smooth. Set aside. Heat oil in a large heavy-bottomed lidded saucepan over high heat until shimmering. Add the curry leaves and chiles and stir till they splutter and release their aroma, about 15 seconds. Reduce heat to medium. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened but not browned, about 5 minutes.

2. Add the spice paste and keep stirring from time to time until it releases an aroma and the oil begins to float on top, about 5 minutes. Add water, stir, close the lid and bring the curry to the boil. Once boiled, check seasoning and add salt if needed. Reduce heat to low and slide in the fish fillets until they are totally immersed in the curry. Let the fish cook gently for 5 minutes without stirring. Serve immediately with steamed white rice.

c.t: Frozen ají amarillo peppers and jarred ají amarillo paste are sold in Latin groceries and online; paste made from frozen peppers has more floral, fruity flavour.
Choclo is a Peruvian corn with large white kernels, sold frozen; boil it for several minutes until tender before serving.
Mrazené papričky ají amarillo aj pastu ají amarillo v pohári dostanete v latinskoamerických obchodoch a online; pasta z mrazených papričiek má výraznejšiu kvetinovú a ovocnú chuť.
Choclo je peruánska kukurica s veľkými bielymi zrnami, predáva sa mrazená; pred podávaním ju niekoľko minút varte do mäkka.

en.t: 225 g frozen aji amarillo peppers (about 6 peppers) or 120 ml aji amarillo paste
170 g sashimi-grade fish, such as salmon, yellowtail (hamachi), fluke, or corvina
180 ml fresh lime juice from about 10 limes
2 medium cloves garlic
One 2.5 cm knob peeled fresh ginger (about 10 g)
Kosher salt
1 tsp (5 ml) minced fresh cilantro leaves and tender stems
Choclo and/or cooked and peeled sweet potato rounds, for garnish (optional)

en.t: 1. If using frozen ají amarillo chiles: In a medium pot, cover chiles with water (they will float) and bring to a boil. Boil for 10 minutes, stirring pot from time to time to rotate peppers. Remove from heat and drain. Allow to cool.
2. Meanwhile, using a sharp slicing knife, slice fish into thin slabs. Arrange slices on plates and transfer to refrigerator.
3. In a blender, combine lime juice with garlic and ginger and blend on high speed until garlic and ginger are fully processed. Transfer to a medium mixing bowl. Rinse blender jar.

4. Remove and discard seeds and stems from chile peppers. Strip off as much of the chile skin as you can and discard it. Transfer chile flesh to blender jar and blend at high speed, adding only enough water to get things moving, until a smooth purée forms.

5. Stir (120 ml) ají amarillo paste into the lime juice until thoroughly combined. (You can add less or more chile paste to your taste, but keep in mind that in addition to heat and flavor, it also gives the sauce viscosity. If you add too little, the sauce will be very thin.) Season with salt. Reserve remaining ají amarillo paste for another use.

6. Stir in cilantro. Remove plates from refrigerator and spoon sauce on top of fish, lightly coating it (reserve any remaining sauce for another use). If desired, garnish plates with choclo and/or sweet potato. Serve right away.

sk.t: 1. Ak používame mrazené papričky ají amarillo: v strednom hrnci ich zalejeme vodou (budú plávať) a privedieme do varu. Varíme 10 minút a občas premiešame, aby sa papričky otáčali. Odstavíme z ohňa a scedíme. Necháme vychladnúť.
2. Medzitým ostrým nožom na krájanie nakrájame rybu na tenké plátky. Plátky rozložíme na taniere a dáme do chladničky.
3. V mixéri spojíme limetkovú šťavu s cesnakom a zázvorom a na vysokých otáčkach mixujeme, kým sa cesnak a zázvor úplne nerozmixujú. Preložíme do strednej misy. Nádobu mixéra opláchneme.

4. Z papričiek odstránime a vyhodíme semienka a stopky. Stiahneme z nich čo najviac šupky a vyhodíme ju. Dužinu papričiek preložíme do nádoby mixéra a na vysokých otáčkach rozmixujeme na hladké pyré; pridáme len toľko vody, aby sa mixér rozbehol.

5. Do limetkovej šťavy vmiešame 120 ml pasty ají amarillo, kým sa dôkladne nespojí. (Pasty môžeme pridať menej alebo viac podľa chuti, ale okrem pálivosti a chuti dáva omáčke aj hustotu. Ak jej pridáme príliš málo, omáčka bude veľmi riedka.) Osolíme. Zvyšnú pastu ají amarillo odložíme na iné použitie.

6. Vmiešame koriandrovú vňať. Taniere vyberieme z chladničky a omáčkou lyžicou zľahka polejeme rybu (zvyšok omáčky odložíme na iné použitie). Podľa chuti ozdobíme kukuricou choclo a/alebo batátmi. Hneď podávame.
